notes.title: Patch 1.0.5
notes.notes:
Mac OS users have been suffering from a rendering issue in the citadel area, caused by an OpenGL shader bug. Patch 1.0.5 is fixing this, along with a few other tweaks.

- Fixed stonebarracks OpenGL render bug
- Added small minimum time for trying raise on button press to make hold action more clear
- Fixed 'Power Elixir' and 'Race for the Relic' quests getting stuck at times
- Fixed sound engine issues
- Fixed Draugr Sword icon overflow
- Added missing effect gfx

notes.title: Big Screen Game of the Year + Patch 1.0.4
notes.notes:
The annual Finnish Game Awards were held in Helsinki, Finland on 4th of May, and Undead Horde 2: Necropolis came home with the Big Screen Game of the Year award!

Here's the change log for the accompanying patch:

- Lots of performance improvements
- Added localization Credits
- Fixed inventory stuck on exit
- Fixed 'command cap full' error message when trying to rise unraisable graves
- Spawning a megacoin if loot value is huge, to reduce perf hit on high dimension looting
- Fixed necro urn not breaking at very high dimensions
- More legendary drops at very high level
- Crash bug fix
- Fixed some memory leaks

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.notes:
We have received a bunch of requests for changing the gamepad tooltip icons, and version 1.0.3 is now out with options for xbox, ps4, ps5, or even nintendo switch icons! You can find the selection under Control Options. Mouse cursor hiding should also work better now, when playing with a gamepad.
Meanwhile under Graphics Options, a display selector has appeared over the resolution list for those of you with multiple monitors. A smattering of other tweaks and fixes are along for the ride.

Here's the complete change log, which you can find inside the game as well:

- Added option to change gamepad icon typeset
- Added option to select active display in graphics settings
- Added 1000 gold rewards for returning excess jars/runes/effigies in ng replaying dimension 1
- Fixed bone wall hitting enemy very near player
- Fixed hovering bone walls when casting near ledge
- Fixed soul jar disappear bug
- Fixed cursor hiding when using gamepad
- Clarified a talent description
- Forced 1 unit type to revive wheel when starting ng+ to avoid getting stuck in tutorial
- No respawn button in tutorial
- Fixed Soul Searching quest getting stuck
- Added worldmap hint to a quest shard in The Last Resort
- Forcing raised units to pathfinding grid if spawned inside collider
- Fixed camera distance bug
- Fixed UI shader transition
- Replaced floating fences with bare trees in the first forest level
- Fixed text overflow in Anvil UI with some languages
- Improved performance on initial rubble remove

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Version 1.0.2 is bringing some features and improvements we've received requests for from all of you, so thanks for those!
A preview of the item being crafted has been a particularly requested thing, so that's now here, as well as a keyboard shortcut to the quest log.
Also included is a performanc optimization when applying a rune effect to a large horde, a couple of new item affixes, and a smattering of bug fixes of course.

Here's the change log:

- Added preview of item craft
- Made early levels in Dimension 2+ more difficult
- Reduced the effect of Staff Cooldown reduction item property at higher levels
- Two new item affixes that increase Poison/Fire damage to enemies
- Rebalanced mana costs to be cheaper at lower levels, and more expensive at higher levels
- Rebalanced summons to last longer at lower levels, and less at higher levels
- Fixed loot system bugs
- Fixed stash gamepad tooltips orientation
- Fixed giants not being able to fit into a tunnel at Plunderer's Retreat
- Fixed Dimension 4 not being unlocked
- Fixed Areas Cleared miscalculation

- Added 'Q' as a shortcut button to open Quest Log

- Blocked dropping of items with level req > max player level

notes.title: Rise and Conquer: Undead Horde 2: Necropolis Exiting Early Access!
notes.notes:
Undead Horde 2: Necropolis is now exiting Early Access. The game includes all the planned and unplanned features we aimed to incorporate. Much of the content added during the Early Access period emerged from the EA process itself. Our most sincere gratitude goes to all the players who began playing early!

Here's a pair of pictures from the very beginning to this point.

We started with a rough draft of Necropolis in Dec 2021...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893179/48549291228ac59c7bb4f2e033603501e72157e0.jpg[/img]

...and ended up with a glorious Necropolis in March 2023!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893179/b9ccc502a3848f9e760b11cfc737eebbf5b948fc.jpg[/img]
 
What's next then? We'll be still monitoring your feedback and we will fix any problems which might arise quickly. You can reach us in the Steam discussions or on discord here: http://discord.gg/10tons

At some point there'll be a larger update which may or may not include new features (this depends on whether we encounter some needs which can be addressed effectively). 

And here's the 1.0 change list.

[list]
[*] [b]Opened up NG+ dimensions after 2[/b]
[*] [b]Added Mac support[/b]
[*] [b]Added the rest of the localizations[/b]
[*] Updated Main Menu with new boxshot and layout
[*] Added player highlight option
[*] Fixed chickens not attacking buildings correctly
[*] Fixed missing secret in desert
[*] Fixed level cap bug
[*] Fixed Support unit casting leveling 
[*] Increased cooldown for Heart of Helob
[*] Skeleton Bard's attack speed boosts now lasts as long as the damage boost
[*] Made summoned spiders stronger in Dimension 2+
[*] Reduced xp from monsters in dimensions 2+
[*] Fixed Battle Angel monsterpedia entry
[*] Fixed bug to update shop items localizations when changing language
[*] Fixed unit building upgrade info localization bug
[*] Crash fix in Necrodome
[/list]

notes.title: Undead Horde 2: Necropolis Full Launch This Thursday
notes.notes:
[b]We have a date[/b]: This thursday March 30th! Undead Horde 2: Necropolis will leave Early Access on that day. The game now has all the planned features plus some unplanned features we picked up during the Early Access from all of you guys! Thank you!

We'll be releasing a more complete update announcement on Thursday. We will also have a launch sale roughly similar to EA launch sale. 

If you want to play the full launch version immediately, you can find it [b]in the beta[/b]. Here are the instructions:  https://steamcommunity.com/app/2065810/discussions/0/3720566578371791473/

The full version has all the planned localizations plus an endless NG+: You can play as long as you can survive, but the difficulty increase should bring an end to even the most skilled necromancers in the higher dimensions.

notes.title: Part 3 Now Available!
notes.notes:
Here's our latest update - it will be known as version 0.9.1. Highlights from the update below!

[h2]Part 3[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893179/c41272ba6118e57da5236e9d5d48a9a45f354aa7.jpg[/img]

As we've moved the Part 3 update into main branch everyone can now continue their campaign. You'll be meeting a lot of interesting living like the pirates with their cannons and even more Winterlands inhabitants. 

[h2]New Units[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893179/aabe72da935f502661c11dbf4f26f6f14916f0eb.jpg[/img]

There's a good number of new units in the update including: The Lich, the Skeleton Mage, the Polar Bear, the Giant, the Wraith and the Shaman.

[h2]The Anvil[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893179/13cf000cedf3e5de812812f65f26421a217b8e6d.jpg[/img]

This is the crafting functionality in Undead Horde 2. It works by combining items. The current implementation is as follows.

[b]The Main item[/b] will determine the main function and the first affix.

[b]The Secondary item[/b] will be used to populate the needed affixes (0-3).

[b]The Power item [/b] is used to determine the rarity & power level of the item.

There are some other rules also like the item DPS or other main attribute should be higher than the Main Item used if the main is lower than the power item. Also affixes will be generated randomly if there aren't enough in the first two items.

[h2]What's Next[/h2]

We're currently working on smaller update which opens new Necrodome areas and includes more fixes. This is mostly done so we're preparing to publish this in beta. We're also working on [b]Part 4[/b] - the next major update - it will also arrive in beta soon.

notes.title: 0.8.3 - Necrodome Available!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893179/ba0697ed1e072b992f591958308d8021dac30b64.png[/img]

Alright, this is our first post-holiday update. It includes the Necrodome which went into beta before the holidays and the fixes and improvements we made last week.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893179/b8ee5ec2aab3fd0aea4378f0e775a6301d090d29.jpg[/img]

The Necrodome is an endless challenge mode with highscores and leaderboards. You can fight against the enemies you've encountered in the biomes you've conquered. Currently two biomes are open Swamp and Forest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893179/f069da14cd5a631699c8c5b94397f4b3dee215ee.jpg[/img]

You'll get the item required for Necrodome reconstruction through a quest or - if you're past that point in game - by talking to one of the Nobles in the Necropolis.

At the moment we're working on finailzing Part 3. If everything goes to plan, it might be in beta by the end of the week!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893179/3379c868168d4357756a7f65877e64ea349c07cd.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
So, we finally published the Steam page for Undead Horde 2: Necropolis. Welcome! We wanted to show a lot of varied game content from our different environments before going live so it took us until early September to reach this point. I'll start our updates with a brief history of the project and where we are at this point and what we're doing next.

Undead Horde is our second best selling title to date after DYSMANTLE, so making a sequel has been on the table for some time. Also, after many of us working over four years on DYSMANTLE (and some of us are still working on DYSMANTLE) and after releasing Skeletal Avengers, we wanted to do a project which we could finish in a bit over a year or so. With this background we decided it would be a suitable time to continue the Undead Horde saga a bit!

In early 2022 we started working. The goal was to create a game which is definitely Undead Horde, but with enough changes to offer something fresh.

There are three major differences with UH2 compared to UH1. I'll outline them here so you know better what to expect.

The first major difference are the raise mechanics. In UH1 you could raise only the exact unit you just killed. In this game we have something called the "Raise Wheel". You can assign 1-5 units onto the wheel and then decide on the go which unit you want to raise from enemy [b]remains[/b]. Enemies leave behind [b]remains[/b] which are the source of your undead warriors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893179/c6bf8d3b57f5e9b85b36e340ddd895d103b3ca4f.gif[/img]

The second major difference is the game hub. In UH1 it was called the crypt but in UH2 you get a whole city called Necropolis. In the beginning the city is razed by the living. In the process they also capture all the denizens into soul jars and take them back to the lands of the living. These were just some innocent souls frolicking happily in the Necropolis after their death. However, the living invented this thing called Soul Jar which they use to capture the souls back. The souls are not happy for this: Who would like to live in a jar for all eternity. 

In any case - the player's goal is to rebuild the Necropolis and bring back its denizens. Each additional denizen can be assigned to a building which can yield various benefits like new abilities, perks or stat bonuses. They also make the city more lively as they walk around.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893179/8f6344367555406353a65c91096f8ee3f13ce550.jpg[/img]

The third major difference is connected to the first. Since the connection between the raised unit and killed unit is broken, we are now able to create a unique set of minions for the player. There are over a dozen types which are all unique. They include your standard skeletons but then extend to more exotic units like hierophants, liches and death knights.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893179/6aa38923b3afe62aa01e7403e8248b9794a1ca40.jpg[/img]

So those were the three major differences. There are more, but these are the most obvious. They make the game feel fresh as even the core gameplay changes a bit when you can decide which kind of undead you raise instead of just mirroring the enemy throughout the whole game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893179/cba130e51df86b757b1fab2dfce82e7c1b881e2c.jpg[/img]

Currently we're working on polishing the first chapter on the game and and some parts of the second and third chapters. This will most likely be the extent of our early access release. We'll be looking for alpha testers in the near future, so stay tuned for that and join our discord for all the latest 10tons gossip: https://discord.gg/10tons
